title: Append-only recovery audit held outside the estate being recovered
description:
## BLUF

Today's audit for the credential-recovery path is **best-effort, fire-and-forget, and lives inside the estate being recovered** — so the one incident where it matters most is the one where it is least trustworthy.

Carried over from @peter's §4 candidate on KS-480, unchanged.

## Detail

* The rotate handler's audit write is `.catch(() => {})` — `services/api-gateway/src/routes/platform.ts:698-709`. A failed audit write is silently dropped and the rotate still succeeds.
* `GET /api/audit` is memory-backed (`services/security/src/index.ts:597`), and under fail-closed RLS the boot warm loads nothing (see [KS-578](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-578)).
* The records live in the same Postgres instance as the data being recovered. A compromise or loss that triggers a bulk re-key is exactly the event that can take the evidence of the re-key with it.

**Scope:** an append-only record of recovery actions (who, which refs, when, outcome per ref) written outside the estate, where a failed write is a **loud** failure rather than a swallowed one.

**Done when:** a bulk re-key produces a durable, append-only record that survives loss of the primary estate, and a failed audit write cannot pass silently.

Sizing: 3–5 days.

---

*Split from* [KS-480](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-480) *per @kamil.kreiser's ruling 2026-08-07.* [KS-579](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-579)*–*[KS-582](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-582) *are @peter's own candidates carried over unchanged;* [KS-577](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-577) *and* [KS-578](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-578) *are additions from the 2026-08-06 verification. Findings checked against* `develop` `c8ce65dca`*; Finding B confirmed live on the demo VM read-only.*
